# Fronz

> Senior go-to-market judgment for bootstrapped–Series A founders: gain clarity, build momentum, know what to run next. Founded and run by Stacey Fronek.

Fronz is a go-to-market practice for bootstrapped–Series A founders and lean teams (roughly 1–30 staff). You execute; Fronz brings senior judgment in bounded containers — not open-ended agency engagements. Every path starts with the free GTM Clarity Starter map.

## Services

- [GTM Clarity](https://fronzz.com/gtm-clarity): Clarity, momentum, and senior judgment for founders who execute. Free GTM Clarity Starter → Starter Review → GTM Review Container ($500/mo) → GTM Intensive ($2,500) → GTM Sprint ($7,500) → scoped follow-on.
- [Groundswell AI Customer Discoverability](https://fronzz.com/groundswell): Phase 2 — AI visibility after messaging and wedge are live. Entry: Visibility Audit, $1,500.

## How we work

- You execute; Fronz interprets and sets the next move.
- Named containers with fixed scope, fixed price, and fixed caps.
- GTM Review Container: monthly senior judgment while you ship — bounded, not always-on.

## Key pages

- [GTM Clarity Starter](https://fronzz.com/starter): Free 20-minute exercise to map offers, customers, and tactics on one page.
- [Book a Starter Review](https://fronzz.com/book): Twenty minutes to reflect your map back after you complete the Starter.
